title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
而在通往宾夕法尼亚州的公路上，卢克还不知道自己被发现了。他此时正趴在货车车顶，忍受着剧烈的颠簸，同时在心里吐槽，他们国家是不是太自由了点。像下面这种不知道有没有看过交规的离谱家伙都能成为长途货车司机。擦擦！！！好在这种折磨并没有持续太久。很快，卢克的目的地就到了。这名不靠谱司机的送货地点竟然也是女妖镇，而且还是女妖镇内一个规模很大的赌场。放眼望去，赌场外面停着的全部都是豪车。一些衣着清凉、穿着暴露的年轻女孩三三两两站在赌场外面，像是等待主人挑选的小白兔。“哈哈，朱莉亚，好久不见，你看起来还是那么美丽迷人......”把车停好的货车司机用异常熟练的姿态走过去，搂着一个浓妆艳抹的丰满少妇上下其手，调起了情。“？？？”而目睹这一切的卢克.邓肯满脸问号，很想问一句这里他妈是印第安保留地？在他的刻板印象里，印第安保留地不应该是保留着传统建筑，既贫穷又落后的地方吗？？可他现在看到的却是满满的拉斯维加斯画风，在卢克看来充满了违和感。“嘿，那边的家伙，你趴在车顶做什么？”这时候，有一个过来搬货的赌场工作人员发现了卢克的存在，从腰间拔出枪快步走过来。但等他靠近货车的同时，车顶上已经空无一人。跟他一同过来的两名印第安壮汉看向他，调笑道：“猎鹰，看来你的眼睛也有看错的时候。”“不可能啊。”名为猎鹰的印第安壮汉抬头四顾，神色有些不可思议地道：“我刚才明明看到了车顶上有一个人。”......得益于1988年联邦政府通过的《印第安博彩管理法》，以及印第安部落在自家保留地内一定程度上的自治权。他们在保留地内开设赌场，不仅不违法，反而被联邦州政府视为一种促进经济发展、创造就业、增加收入并且改善基础设施的重要手段。以上都是卢克刚从网上搜到的原话。考虑到他现在基本上衣不蔽体的状态，他刚才悄悄潜入小镇一栋无人房屋，在里面找了几件符合他身材大小的衣服，并且用主卧的电脑搜索了一些有关于印第安部落的信息。然而不搜还好，仔细一搜，他更懵逼了。根据网上的信息，印第安人现在可不是影视宣传里的那样贫穷、淳朴、落后。恰恰相反，保留着相对独立自主权的他们，在保留地内大力发展博彩、色情、旅游行业，甚至军火、毒品生意也一个不落，将这些黑色产业发展得如火如荼，很多从他们这里进货的黑帮都要看他们的眼色行事。这让打算来这里睹物思人，了解自己母亲曾经过往的卢克，彻底陷入了迷茫状态。他有些失魂破落地走在小镇街道上，不知道自己下一步该做什么。“这位先生是来我们这里旅游的吗，要不要试一试我们印第安部落的占卜，我们的女巫今年都快一百岁了，很灵的.......”

不知不觉的，卢克走到了小镇西边的旅游区，被一个守在帐篷前、看着有几分机灵的印第安少年拉了进去。“轰！！！”在卢克走进来之后，帐篷内唯一的光源，两团放置在铁盆里的火焰同样膨胀了起来，让卢克正好能看清坐在帐篷中间，头戴彩色羽毛冠，身穿传统服饰，双眼微微泛白的印第安巫女。别的不说，光是这个出场方式就能唬到很多第一次来印第安部落的游客。如果再加上这位巫女脸上层层叠叠的皱纹，以及那双虽然看不见，但仿佛蕴藏着无穷智慧、能够看穿一切的盲眼，能唬到的人就更多了。但身体感官都被大大加强的卢克.邓肯显然不在这些人之列。一些平常人在昏暗环境下很难发现的细节，他一眼就发现了。比如说这位女巫脸上画的皱纹并不够自然，仔细观察的话，还是能够发现一些破绽。还有她脖颈位置虽然用服饰遮挡住了，但还是能看到那里的肤色跟脸上不同。还有她那双盲眼也可能是假的，估计戴着一种特制的美瞳，卢克明显能感觉这个帐篷里除了那个印第安少年之外，还有第二个人在盯着自己。“ausjiaxsh。”这时候，这位女巫坐在那说出一串难懂的话，印第安少年在旁边充当翻译，对卢克道：“女巫说你是有缘人，让你坐下，她会带你感受到神灵的存在，神灵会解答你心中的疑惑。”“......好。”不知道出于什么心理，卢克明知道是假的，但还是鬼使神差地在帐篷里坐了下来，并且依言闭上了自己的眼睛。太好了，终于有人上当了！妈妈这个月的住院费有着落啦！！印第安少年，和盘坐在帐篷中间的‘女巫’见此同时露出一丝喜色。他们两相互对视一眼，按照妈妈平时当女巫的模样开始了下一步表演。“shjkduisi，suaim，skwig......”一连串难懂又深奥的祭词从女巫嘴里念出。她站起来，将一捆提前准备好的药草放进火盆里燃烧，随后晃动手里一个发出沉闷声响的骨器，绕着盘坐闭目的卢克跳起了某种舞蹈。咚！咚咚！！听着这有些熟悉的调子，明知道是假的，卢克的心却快速平静了下来，并且进入了跟上次做梦很像的特殊状态。他再一次来到了那座神圣高大的月亮金字塔。这一次，这上面不再站满了人，而是只有他和戴着黄金面具的大祭司。“修尔斯，伟大雄鹰的后裔啊，卑鄙无耻的西班牙人用计谋和瘟疫攻陷了伟大的特诺奇蒂特兰城，现在还要来抢夺神灵赐予我们的圣器，你答应吗？”“不，绝不！！”“很好，阿兹特克帝国最勇猛的武士啊，带着雨神特拉洛克的面具离开这里吧，越远越好，记住，要用你的生命和灵魂守护它，守护神灵赐予我们的这份荣耀......”
content_en:
On the road to Pennsylvania, Luke didn't know he had been discovered.He was lying on the roof of the truck, enduring the violent bumps, while complaining in his mind whether their country was too free.Ridiculous guys like the one below can become long-distance truck drivers even if they have never read the traffic regulations.Scratch!!!Fortunately, this torture did not last long.Soon, Luke's destination was reached.The delivery location of this unreliable driver turned out to be Banshee Town, and it was also a large casino in Banshee Town.Looking around, all the cars parked outside the casino are luxury cars.Some young girls in cool and scantily clad clothes stood outside the casino in twos and threes, like little white rabbits waiting for the owner to choose."Haha, Julia, long time no see, you still look so beautiful and charming..." The driver of the parked truck walked over with an unusually skillful gesture, put his arm around a plump young woman with heavy makeup, and started flirting with her."???" Luke Duncan, who witnessed all this, had questions on his face. He wanted to ask: Is this an Indian reservation?In his stereotype, shouldn't Indian reservations be places that retain traditional architecture and are poor and backward??But what he sees now is full of Las Vegas style, which seems to be full of contradictions to Luke."Hey, guy over there, what are you doing lying on the roof of the car?" At this time, a casino employee who came to move goods noticed Luke's presence, pulled out a gun from his waist and walked over quickly.But when he approached the truck, there was no one on the roof.The two strong Indian men who came with him looked at him and said teasingly: "Falcon, it seems that your eyes are wrong sometimes." "No way." The strong Indian man named Falcon looked up and looked around with a somewhat incredible look: "I just saw a person on the roof of the car."... Thanks to the "Indian Gaming Management Act" passed by the federal government in 1988, and the Indian tribes' autonomy to a certain extent within their own reservations.Not only is it not illegal for them to open casinos in reservations, but it is regarded by federal and state governments as an important means to promote economic development, create jobs, increase income, and improve infrastructure.The above are the original words that Luke just found from the Internet.Considering that he was basically naked now, he just quietly sneaked into an unoccupied house in the town, found a few clothes that fit his body size, and used the computer in the master bedroom to search for some information about Indian tribes.However, it was okay not to search. After searching carefully, he was even more confused.According to the information on the Internet, Indians are not as poor, simple, and backward as they are in the propaganda of movies and TV shows.On the contrary, they retain relatively independent autonomy and vigorously develop the gambling, pornography, tourism industries, and even the arms and drug business in the reservation area. They have developed these black industries in full swing. Many gangsters who purchase goods from them have to look at their eyes to act.This made Luke, who planned to come here to see things and think about people and understand his mother's past, completely fall into a state of confusion.He was walking on the streets of the town a little lost, not knowing what to do next."Is this gentleman here to travel to us? Do you want to try the divination of our Indian tribe? Our witch is almost a hundred years old this year. She is very spiritual..."

Unknowingly, Luke walked to the tourist area on the west side of the town and was pulled in by an Indian boy who was guarding in front of the tent and looked a bit clever."Boom!!!" After Luke walked in, the only light source in the tent, two flames placed in the iron basin, also expanded, allowing Luke to see clearly the Indian witch sitting in the middle of the tent, wearing a colorful feather crown and traditional costume, with slightly white eyes.Apart from anything else, this way of appearance alone can scare many tourists who come to the Indian tribe for the first time.If you add in the layers of wrinkles on this miko's face and her blind eyes that, although invisible, seem to contain infinite wisdom and can see through everything, she can bluff even more people.But Luke Duncan, whose physical senses have been greatly enhanced, is obviously not among these people.He spotted some details that were difficult for ordinary people to spot in a dark environment at a glance.For example, the wrinkles painted on the face of this witch are not natural enough. If you observe carefully, you can still find some flaws.Also, although her neck is covered with clothing, you can still see that the skin color there is different from her face.Her blind eyes might also be fake. She was probably wearing special contact lenses. Luke could clearly feel that besides the Indian boy, there was a second person staring at him in the tent."ausjiaxsh." At this time, the witch sat there and spoke a string of difficult words. The Indian boy acted as a translator and said to Luke: "The witch said that you are destined to be a destined person. Let you sit down. She will make you feel the presence of the gods, and the gods will answer your doubts."Great, someone finally fell for it!Mom’s hospitalization expenses for this month have been settled!!The Indian boy and the 'witch' sitting cross-legged in the middle of the tent showed a hint of joy at the same time.The two of them looked at each other and started the next step of their performance as their mother usually did when she was a witch."shjkduisi, suaim, skwig..." A series of difficult and profound sacrificial words came from the witch's mouth.She stood up, put a bundle of herbs prepared in advance into the brazier and burned it, then shook a bone tool that made a dull sound in her hand, and danced some kind of dance around Luke who was sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed.Boom!Boom!!Listening to this somewhat familiar tune, even though he knew it was fake, Luke's heart quickly calmed down, and he entered a special state that was very similar to the last dream.He once again came to the sacred and tall Pyramid of the Moon.This time, it was no longer full of people, but only him and the high priest wearing a golden mask."Suls, the descendant of the great eagle, the despicable and shameless Spaniards captured the great city of Tenochtitlan with trickery and plague, and now they are coming to snatch the sacred artifact given to us by the gods. Do you agree?" "No, never!!" "Very good, the bravest warrior in the Aztec Empire, leave here with the mask of Tlaloc, the rain god, as far away as possible. Remember, you must protect it with your life and soul, and protect this honor given to us by the gods..."
